title: Regression-Test Suite for Alignment After Fine-Tuning

original_idea.body:
# Regression-Test Suite for Alignment After Fine-Tuning

**Problem:** Practitioners have no lightweight CI test flagging alignment regressions.

**Direction:** Build a fixed battery of behavioral assertions with thresholds, run before/after benign fine-tunes, report which trigger regressions.

**Why it matters:** A drop-in alignment regression harness for the open community.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2507.03662; TruthfulQA.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A drop-in alignment regression harness lets the open community catch safety erosion; clear infrastructure chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Assemble fixed assertions plus run before/after fine-tunes; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused reusable harness; needs benchmark assembly and several fine-tunes.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-community tooling labs do not own; public models/data.

low_compute.reasoning: Small LoRA runs plus inference; one GPU.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Alignment regression evaluation harnesses already exist.
